caption: The drawing depicts a chandelier suspended from the ceiling by three gold-colored chains that converge at a ring at the top. The main circular body of the chandelier is made of a marbled material featuring shades of cream, pink, and subtle orange. Radiating from the circular body are six gold arms, each curving outward and ending with a teardrop-shaped crystal hanging downward. The central part of the chandelier extends downward into a conical shape, also marbled in cream and pink, and is encircled by a green band near the top. From the lowest point of the chandelier hangs a multicolored tassel with shades of gold, brown, and blue. The background is plain and off-white, showing no additional objects or elements. The artist's name, Edward T. Jewett, is inscribed to the right of the chandelier’s body.
title: Chandelier
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
